issues.title: Dynamic Tailwind Class Construction
issues.description: Using template literals for Tailwind classes won't work with JIT compiler
issues.impact: Feature icons will have no background color, broken visual design
reproduction_steps: Observe missing background colors on feature cards
issues.fix: Use conditional class mapping or complete class names instead of template literals

issues.title: Duplicate Section IDs
issues.description: Both CTA and Footer use id='contact', breaking anchor navigation
issues.impact: Clicking 'Contact' link in header will scroll to wrong section

issues.title: Missing Accessibility Labels
issues.impact: Screen readers can't describe button purpose
issues.wcag_violation: WCAG 2.1 Level A - 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
issues.fix: Add aria-label to all icon buttons

issues.title: Missing Tests
issues.description: No test script configured, no testing framework setup
issues.impact: No automated quality assurance, risk of regressions
issues.fix: Add vitest and testing-library, configure test script

issues.title: Incomplete Meta Tags
issues.description: Missing keywords, canonical URL, theme-color meta tags
issues.impact: Reduced SEO ranking, poor mobile browser integration
issues.fix: Add missing meta tags for SEO and mobile optimization

issues.title: No Loading States
issues.description: No loading skeletons during data fetch
issues.impact: Poor UX, appears frozen during API calls
issues.fix: Implement skeleton loaders for all async operations

issues.title: Missing Structured Data
issues.description: No JSON-LD schema markup for organization, services
issues.impact: Reduced SEO visibility, missing rich snippets in search
issues.fix: Add Schema.org structured data for Organization and SoftwareApplication

issues.title: Non-functional Newsletter
issues.description: Email input has no form handling or submission
issues.impact: Users can't actually subscribe, broken UX expectation
issues.fix: Add form validation and API integration

issues.title: Missing robots.txt Configuration
issues.description: File exists but may not be properly configured
issues.impact: Search engines may not crawl correctly
issues.fix: Review and update robots.txt with sitemap URL

issues.title: No Service Worker
issues.description: No PWA support, no offline capability
issues.impact: Can't install as mobile app, no offline access
issues.fix: Consider adding service worker for PWA features

issues.title: Missing Focus Indicators
issues.description: Focus styles may not be visible in all themes
issues.impact: Keyboard navigation users can't see focus
issues.fix: Ensure consistent focus-visible styles across all interactive elements

issues.title: No Image Optimization
issues.description: Hero image lacks responsive srcset, loading='lazy'
issues.impact: Slower page load, poor mobile performance
issues.fix: Add responsive image attributes and lazy loading

issues.title: Hardcoded Text Content
issues.description: No i18n framework, text is hardcoded
issues.fix: Consider adding react-i18next if internationalization needed

issues.title: Missing Error Boundaries on Routes
issues.description: While root has ErrorBoundary, individual routes don't
issues.impact: Errors in one route can crash entire app

issues.title: Console Logging in Production
issues.impact: Exposes internal details, minor performance cost
issues.fix: Add build-time removal of console statements

issues.title: No Storybook
issues.impact: Harder for team to discover and reuse components
issues.fix: Consider adding Storybook for component development

issues.title: Missing Lighthouse CI
issues.fix: Add Lighthouse CI to GitHub Actions

positive_findings: Clean component structure with separation of concerns
Comprehensive CSS variables and design system
